name: Import Manager
description: The map's imported files (war3map.imp) like the World Editor's Import Manager: import files from disk, change their path in the archive, export, open, remove, list files in the map that aren't registered, and clean up the list (entries without a file out, unlisted files in).

mcpTools.name: import_file
mcpTools.description: Imports a file from this computer into the map (a campaign project: into the campaign): copies it into the map folder and lists it in the import list, as the Import Manager's Import files does. The open Import Manager shows it at once. Without path it goes to war3mapImported\<its name>; a path of a game file (like Units\Human\Footman\Footman.mdx) replaces that file in this map. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes the list entry back, not the copied file.

source.description: The file's full path on this computer.

path.description: Its path in the map, with \ or /. Must be free.

mcpTools.name: remove_import
mcpTools.description: Takes a file off the map's import list, as one edit; with deleteFile its file is deleted from the map folder too (otherwise it is still packed into the map). What names the file (models, object data, triggers) is not changed: list_problems shows it. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit puts the entry back, not a deleted file.

path.description: The import's path, as list_imports gives it.

deleteFile.description: Also delete the file. Default false.

mcpTools.name: list_imports
mcpTools.description: The map's import list (a campaign project: the campaign's): each entry's path, the project file it stands for and its size, or missing: true when the project has no such file; unlisted names the files in the map folder that no entry stands for (packed into the map all the same).
